question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"inherited"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank number **1** is **'inherited.'**
 
• **Inherited:** (of money, property, or a title) received as an heir at the death of the previous holder.
 
 
• **Example: ***inherited money/property.*
